captions.text: Her son forwards the ticket. Muse Spark reads it; the journey is built: HYD → DOH → DFW, 15 stages.
captions.vo: He forwards her ticket on WhatsApp. Muse Spark reads it into an itinerary, and the journey is built: fifteen stages, Hyderabad to Dallas.

captions.text: Her voice note: “start my trip.” She hears: “All right. Your trip has started. I will tell you what to do when it is time.”
captions.vo: She says “start my trip”, in Telugu. Voice Transcribe and Spark understand her, and she hears — [pause: her voice note plays]

captions.text: Check-in, at its time — her phone (right): the card and the note. “Go to the Qatar Airways counter. Give passport and ticket. Hand over the big bag. Take the boarding pass.”
captions.vo: At check-in time she gets a card with the word on the board, and a voice note. [pause: her voice note plays]

captions.text: Every stage fires on the journey's clock: security, gate, boarding, the flight, Doha. Code owns the timing.
captions.vo: Every stage fires on the journey's clock. Code owns the timing — the model never does.

captions.text: Doha. Her next gate is not announced yet — and that is exactly what she is told.
captions.vo: Doha. Her next gate isn't announced yet, and Concourse says exactly that.

captions.text: A verified operations event sets gate D14 (simulated, labelled). Her phone: the new card and note. His phone: the update.
captions.vo: A verified operations event sets gate D14 — simulated here, and labelled. Both phones get it. [pause: her voice note plays]

captions.text: Her voice note: “Where is my gate?” She hears: “Your Qatar Airways flight leaves from gate D14. Again: gate D14. See the card.”
captions.vo: She asks where her gate is. Answered from verified facts only: [pause: her voice note plays — “your flight leaves from gate D14”]

captions.text: Her photo of a sign. SAM 3.1 finds the board, Spark reads it: gates B. She hears: “This board is not your gate. Yours is D14. Look for boards that say D.”
captions.vo: She photographs a sign. SAM finds the board, Spark reads it: gates B. That's a mismatch, and she's told so. [pause: her voice note plays] No route is invented.

captions.text: Her voice note: “I'm lost.” She gets her card and calm words; her son gets a message. No one claims to know where she is.
captions.vo: “I'm lost.” [pause: her voice note plays] Her son is told. Concourse never claims to know where she is.

captions.text: Boarding, the long flight, Dallas: arrivals, immigration (she answers the officer herself), baggage, exit.
captions.vo: Boarding, the long flight, Dallas. Arrivals, immigration — she answers the officer herself — baggage, exit.

captions.text: Outside, she presses “I'm here.” Her son's phone: journey complete.
captions.vo: Outside, she presses “I'm here”. [pause: her voice note plays] Not tracked. She told her family.

card_vo.c1: Everything you're about to see was built between October 26th and November 4th.
card_vo.c2: My mother can fly nine thousand miles alone. The part she can't do is read the airport.
card_vo.c3: Her son sets it up because she can't. Spark interprets her, code controls the journey, and nothing is ever invented.
card_vo.c4: Every model that runs is Meta's — Spark, SAM 3.1, Voice Transcribe, and MMS for her voice — on WhatsApp, the app she already has.
card_vo.c5: Thirty-six safety cases green in CI. A hundred and three model calls, replayed from a recorded run. Zero invented directions. Concourse.
